origin.description: Alias of testFunction. True when the value is a function with the requested formals.
origin.usage: test_function(x, args = NULL, ordered = FALSE, nargs = NULL, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x

arguments.name: args
arguments.text: Formal argument names the function must have.

arguments.name: ordered
